Class WasmModule

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.wasm.WasmModule
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public abstract class WasmModule extends Object implements Closeable
Shared base for the low-level bindings to the codec WASM modules (c2pa_wasm, ultrahdr_wasm, jxl_wasm).

Every codec binding duplicates the same plumbing: loading the module from a file, a raw byte array or the classpath, creating the WasmEngine and the bound WasmMemory, and releasing the engine on close(). That boilerplate lives here; concrete subclasses only declare their #[no_mangle] pub extern "C" export methods (e.g. uhdr_decode, jxl_decode) and the accessors they expose with their desired visibility.

Each module is executed by a pluggable WasmEngine: by default the pure-JVM Chicory interpreter (works on every JVM), with an automatic switch to GraalVM's WebAssembly runtime when running on a GraalVM that has the polyglot artifacts on the classpath. See WasmEngine.create(String, byte[]).

This class is Closeable; always call close() (or use try-with-resources) to release the engine.

      protected static byte[] fromClasspathBytes(String resourceName) throws IOException
      Read the raw WASM module bytes from the classpath.

      Checks the resource /<name> first, then /wasm/<name> (the location used by the Maven build).

      Parameters:
      resourceName - The wasm file name, e.g. "c2pa_wasm.wasm".
      Returns:
      Raw WASM binary bytes.
      Throws:
      IOException - if the resource is not found or cannot be read.

    • wasmAlloc

      public int wasmAlloc(int size)
      wasm_alloc(size: u32) -> *mut u8

      Allocate size zeroed bytes in WASM linear memory. The caller MUST eventually free the result with wasmFree(int, int).

      Parameters:
      size - Number of bytes to allocate (must be > 0).
      Returns:
      WASM linear memory address of the allocated buffer.

    • wasmFree

      public void wasmFree(int ptr, int size)
      wasm_free(ptr: *mut u8, size: u32)

      Free memory previously allocated by wasmAlloc(int) or returned as an output buffer by any function in this module.

      Parameters:
      ptr - WASM linear memory address to free (ignored if 0).
      size - Number of bytes that were allocated (ignored if 0).
